|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Puncture''' is a [[bow]] [[attack]] skill that applies the [[Bleed]] [[ailment]] to enemies it hits, causing them to take physical [[damage over time]] that increases while the target is moving. Bleed applied with this skill deals more damage than usual. ==Mechanics== Unlike other sources of bleed, Puncture's bleed ailment lasts 8 seconds and is affected by {{c|mod|% increased Skill Effect Duration}} modifier, including the {{il|Increased Duration}} support gem. For mechanics of the bleed effect itself, see [[Bleed]]. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_header = x% more Damage with Bleeding |c1_abbr = Bleeding Damage |c1_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% more Damage with Bleeding |c1_pattern_value = %d%% }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * No longer has Added Attack Physical Damage at all gem levels. * It now has 168% Effectiveness of Base and Added Damage at gem level 1 (previously 135%), scaling up to 205% at gem level 20 (previously 165%). * Now has a Mana cost of 8 at gem level 1, scaling up to 14 at gem level 20 (previously 6 at all gem levels). * Some attack skills that can be used ranged or melee have had their weapon requirements split between the base Gem and their Transfigured Gem: The '''Puncture''' Skill Gem now requires a Bow, while the new Puncture of Shanking Transfigured Gem requires a Dagger, Claw, or Sword. }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now provides +0-20% more Damage with Bleeding, instead of causing Bleeding inflicted by this Skill to deal Damage 0-10% faster. }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * The following [[Strike|Skills]] no longer have “+0-2 to Melee Strike Range”: {{il|Dominating Blow}}, {{il|Double Strike}}, {{il|Vaal Double Strike}}, {{il|Dual Strike}}, {{il|Elemental Hit}}, {{il|Frenzy}}, {{il|Infernal Blow}}, {{il|Pestilent Strike}}, [[Puncture]], {{il|Riposte}}, {{il|Static Strike}}, {{il|Smite}}, {{il|Viper Strike}}, and {{il|Wild Strike}}. }} {{Version history table row|3.7.0| * Now deals base damage equal to, and has an added damage effectiveness of, 135% at gem level 1 (from 100%), up to 165% at gem level 20 (from 123%). * Now adds 3 to 4 physical damage to attacks at gem level 1, up to 75 to 113 at gem level 20. * Now deals 30% more damage with bleeding at gem level 1, up to 49% more at gem level 20. * Now has an attack speed multiplier of 70%. * Now causes bleeding inflicted by the skill to deal damage 0.5% faster per 1% gem quality (previously gained 1% increased skill duration per 1% gem quality). }} {{Version history table row|3.4.0| * Now gain additional melee weapon range every 7 levels, up to +2 at level 20 (and +3 at level 21) }} {{Version history table row|3.0.0| * Puncture's description has been updated. Puncture now applies Bleeding for 8 seconds. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Now grants 1% increased skill effect duration per 1% quality (was 1.5% per 1% quality). }} {{Version history table row|1.3.0| * Puncture now bleeds for 10% of hit damage at all levels and 50% of hit damage while moving. }} {{Version history table row|1.2.0| * Fixed a bug where Puncture did not benefit from Increased Item Rarity or Increased Item Quantity. }} {{Version history table row|1.0.2| * Generic modifiers to damage dealt will now apply to damage over time that your character causes. Damage over time is not spell damage, nor attack damage, so modifiers specific to those types will not apply. Non-specific "increased damage" modifiers will apply to damage over time. Type-specific modifiers will apply as well. }} {{Version history table row|1.0.0d| *Fixed a bug where monster deaths from Puncture were not awarded as kills correctly. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.8| * Increased damage at high levels and Physical Damage % added to it that increases each level, to match other similar skills. * May now be used with Two Handed Swords. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.0| * Increases to physical damage taken now apply correctly to physical degeneration
(such as damage from Puncture). }} {{Version history table row|0.9.13| * Puncture is now scaled to start much stronger with a flatter progression to match
other [[melee]] skills that scale weapon damage. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.11j| * Fixed Puncture's quality bonus so that it now works. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.11| * Fixed a bad interaction between on-drink flask effects and Puncture. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.10| * Fixed a rare bug that would cause you to take damage from Puncture indefinitely until you left the instance. * Fixed a bug where being punctured multiple times would cause incorrect behaviour. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.7b| * Removed the 1% pierce chance. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.7| * Puncture has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Skills}}
